decisions.label: Her light's reach in the wild
decisions.note: How far her light reaches exploring an area the party hasn't reached, times its reach on party ground (combatLight.wildReach) (Ed, 2026-11-12: "Can you make a new pause menu group that has each of these applied in the wild only so I can tweak them?"): 1 as far as on party ground, 0.65 as built. A fight near her lifts it back up. Eased in and out as she crosses. Live.

decisions.label: Her light's strength in the wild
decisions.note: How bright her light is in the wild, times its strength on party ground (combatLight.wildGlow): 1 as bright, 0.6 as built. A fight near her lifts it back up. Live.

decisions.label: Her glow cooled in the wild
decisions.note: How far her glow's colour is cooled toward the colour below in the wild (light.spooky.wildGlow.mix; Ed, 2026-10-29: "an eerie blue/green"): 0 her own colour everywhere, 0.7 as built, 1 all that colour. The same slider as Wild light's. Eased in and out as she crosses. Live.

decisions.label: Her glow in the wild: colour (hue)
decisions.note: The colour her glow cools toward in the wild, round the colour wheel (0.51 the teal as built); the swatch is the colour. Live.

decisions.label: Her glow in the wild: colour (saturation)
decisions.note: 0 white, 1 the hue at its deepest (0.61 as built). Live.

decisions.label: Wild grade: strength
decisions.note: A colour grade over the picture in the wild only (Ed, 2026-11-12: "Can you make a new pause menu group that has each of these applied in the wild only so I can tweak them?"): never on party ground or home, eased in and out as she crosses at the area moods' pace. Laid after the Spooky colour grade, which applies everywhere: in the wild both apply, one then the other. 0 off (as built). Live.

decisions.label: Wild grade: drain colour
decisions.note: How much colour the wild grade drains from the dark and middle tones before tinting them: 0 none, 1 grey. Shows only with the wild grade's strength above 0. Live.

decisions.label: Wild grade: brightness it stops at
decisions.note: The brightness above which the wild grade leaves the picture alone, so her light and bright things keep their colour: lower grades only the darkest. Live.

decisions.label: Wild grade: tint (hue)
decisions.note: The colour the wild grade tints toward, round the colour wheel (0.5 teal, 0.62 blue, 0.75 violet); the swatch is the colour. Live.

decisions.label: Wild grade: tint (saturation)
decisions.note: How deep the wild grade's tint is: 0 none (only drained), 1 the hue at its deepest. Live.
